site.name: shopify
site.summary: shopify-clone Clone of the Shopify marketing → trial → admin funnel. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: hero ("Your business starts with Shopify" + email signup input), product features, customer success stories, customer logos, footer | | `pricing.html` | Plan comparison: Basic / Shopify / Advanced three tiers, monthly / yearly toggle, feature comparison table, FAQ | | `free-trial.html` | Trial landing page: 3-step intro to the trial flow, value props restated, large "Start free trial" button |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Shopify system, prioritizing the primary form/onboarding flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start by traversing the primary onboarding funnel from the homepage email input through the multi-step trial form to completion. It will then validate adjacent flows including the login, enterprise sales contact form, and pricing toggle interactions. Finally, it will assess content pages, error handling, and mobile responsiveness, paying close attention to the numerous small tap targets and missing input labels identified in the prescan.
assumptions: The multi-step form on free-trial-form.html reveals subsequent steps (location, account creation) interactively via the 'Next' button rather than loading new pages.
The login and sales forms will display inline validation errors when submitted with invalid or empty data.
The monthly/yearly toggle on pricing.html dynamically updates the plan prices and feature details.
Footer links pointing to '#' (e.g., Solutions, About, Careers) are placeholder links and will not navigate to new content.
risk_hotspots: free-trial-form.html: Multi-step form progression, skip functionality, and validation error recovery paths.
sales.html: Missing input labels for phone number and company size fields, which harms accessibility and could confuse users.
admin.html: Login error states and social login (Apple/Google/Facebook) fallback behavior.
pricing.html: Accurate dynamic updating of prices and feature details when toggling between monthly and yearly billing.
Global: Widespread small tap targets in the header, footer, and navigation links, posing a significant mobile UX risk.

phases.title: Primary Onboarding Funnel
phases.objective: Validate the core conversion path from the homepage email input through the multi-step trial signup form.
key_checks: Submit the homepage email form with an invalid format and verify inline error handling.
Submit the homepage email form with a valid email and confirm navigation to free-trial-form.html.
Progress through the 'What are you planning to sell?' step, selecting various options.
Test the 'Skip all' functionality and verify it bypasses remaining steps appropriately.
Complete the multi-step form to the 'Your store is ready!' state, ensuring smooth transitions.
exit_criteria: Successful completion of the trial form to the final success state.
Validation error triggered and displayed for invalid email input.

phases.title: Authentication & Recovery
phases.objective: Test the login flow, including error states, social login options, and navigation to signup.
key_checks: Attempt to log in with empty fields and verify error messaging.
Attempt to log in with invalid credentials and verify error messaging.
Check the 'Forgot password?' link behavior.
Verify navigation from 'New to Shopify? Start free trial' back to the onboarding flow.
exit_criteria: Login validation errors observed for empty and invalid inputs.
Forgot password and signup navigation paths verified.

phases.title: Pricing & Enterprise Contact
phases.objective: Validate the pricing page interactions and the enterprise sales contact form, including accessibility issues.
key_checks: Toggle between 'Pay monthly' and 'Pay yearly' and verify price/feature updates.
Expand FAQ accordions and verify content visibility.
On sales.html, submit the form with empty required fields to trigger validation.
Verify the accessibility and labeling of the company size and topic select dropdowns on sales.html.
Navigate via the 'View pricing' link back to pricing.html.
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle successfully updates plan details.
Sales form validation triggered for empty inputs.
Missing label accessibility issue confirmed on sales.html.

phases.title: Content & Help Pages
phases.objective: Explore the resources and help center pages to ensure navigation and search functionality operate correctly.
key_checks: Verify navigation links to Help Center, Academy, Theme Store, and App Store from resources.html.
Test the search input on help-trial.html.
Click the table of contents links (e.g., 'Initiate the free trial') and verify scroll/navigation behavior.
Verify inline links (e.g., 'sign up for a free trial') navigate correctly.
exit_criteria: Help center search and navigation functioning.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical flows and high-risk areas on a mobile viewport to assess responsiveness and tap target issues.
key_checks: Verify homepage hero and email input adapt properly to mobile viewport.
Assess the multi-step trial form usability on mobile, checking for layout shifts or obscured inputs.
Evaluate the pricing toggle and comparison table readability on mobile.
Confirm the severity of small tap targets identified in the prescan (header nav, footer links).
exit_criteria: Critical flows validated on mobile viewport.
Tap target and layout warnings documented with visual evidence.

coverage_targets.features: exercise all form inputs, validation states, toggles, and key navigation links per page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks on mobile viewport, specifically targeting known small tap targets and form usability

notes: free-trial.html appears to be a duplicate of index.html based on the prescan; verify if it behaves differently or is just a variant.
Focus heavily on the missing input labels on sales.html and the small tap targets across the site during the mobile phase.
Several footer links point to '#'; note these as dead ends in the UX critique rather than attempting to navigate them repeatedly.

Allbirds Gymshark Brooklinen Leesa Kylie Cosmetics Crate & Barrel Monos CUSTOMIZABLE THEMES Create a stunning store in seconds Pre-built designs make it fast and easy to kickstart your brand. Plus, earn up to £7,000 in credits as you sell. Start free trial You agree to receive Shopify marketing emails. Questions? What is Shopify and how does it work? Shopify is a complete commerce platform that lets you start, grow, and manage a business. With Shopify, you can build an online store, manage sales, market to customers, and accept payments in digital and physical locations. How much does Shopify cost? Try Shopify free for 3 days, no credit card required. After your trial expires, choose a pricing plan that suits the size and stage of your business. Can I use my own domain name with Shopify? Yes, you can use your own domain name with Shopify. If you have an existing domain name, you can connect it to Shopify from your store's admin. If you don't have a domain name yet, you can either buy one through Shopify or a third-party provider. Do I need to be a designer or developer to use Shopify? No, you don't need to be a designer or developer to use Shopify. Signing up for Shopify allows you to use pre-built themes, drag-and-drop editors, and AI tools to create your store without any coding knowledge. Allbirds Gymshark Brooklinen Patagonia Crate & Barrel Frequently asked questions What is Shopify and how does it work? Shopify is a complete commerce platform that lets you start, grow, and manage a business. You can use Shopify to build an online store, manage sales, market to customers, and accept payments in digital and physical locations. How much does Shopify cost? Shopify plans start at £25/month for Basic. You can try any plan free for 3 days, then enjoy £1/month for your first 3 months. No credit card required to start. How long are your contracts? Shopify plans are month-to-month by default. You can also choose annual billing for a discount. There are no long-term contracts — you can cancel at any time. Can I cancel my account at any time? Yes, you can cancel your Shopify account at any time. If you cancel during your free trial, you won't be charged. If you cancel after selecting a plan, your store will remain active until the end of your current billing period. Can I change my plan later on? Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your Shopify admin. Changes take effect immediately, and any price differences are prorated. Are there third-party transaction fees? If you use Shopify Payments, there are no additional transaction fees. If you use a third-party payment provider, additional fees of 2%, 1%, or 0.6% apply depending on your plan (Basic, Grow, or Advanced). observation.title: Trying Shopify with a free trial – Shopify Help Center
observation.visible_text: Shopify Help Center ON THIS PAGE Available plans for trial Initiate the free trial Setting up your store Making the most of your trial Choosing a paid plan Trial period length Promotional pricing Deactivating your store Troubleshooting Trying Shopify with a free trial To explore Shopify before committing to an active monthly plan, you can sign up for a free trial. Your free trial begins when you first sign up, not when you start working on your store. Available plans for trial The free trial allows you to test out various Shopify plans, including: Starter Basic Grow Advanced Shopify Retail Initiate the free trial Visit the free trial page, enter your email address, and then click Start free trial. Answer a set of questions tailored to your business needs, or choose Skip All. Specify your business location. Create a Shopify account to start your free trial. Setting up your store during the free trial When you open a store on a free trial, your store initially has either a storefront password or an inactive checkout. To allow customers to purchase products, you can either remove the storefront password, or you can activate your online store checkout by choosing a paid plan. To sell and accept orders during your free trial, you need to set up a payment provider. You won't lose any work completed on your store during the free trial when you select a paid plan. Making the most of your free trial During your free trial period, you have the opportunity to set up your store and explore its features. Here are some ways to maximize your trial experience: Add products: Populate your store with a few products and ensure their product details are displayed correctly on your online store. Create collections: Organize your products by creating collections to enhance the shopping experience for your customers. Explore settings: Familiarize yourself with the Settings page in your Shopify admin to configure taxes, shipping, and other sales channels. Set up payments: Configure Shopify Payments or verify that your preferred third-party payment provider is supported by Shopify. Visit the theme and app store: Visit the Shopify Theme Store and the Shopify App Store to discover themes and apps that can enhance your store's functionality and appearance. Choosing a paid plan When you're ready to start selling products, you need to select a paid plan. Any progress you made during your free trial, including products added, designs made, and settings adjusted are retained when you choose a paid plan. Review the following considerations before choosing a paid plan: Store activation: After you choose a paid plan, your online store's checkout is activated. Trial expiry: If you don't select a monthly plan at the end of your free trial, then your store is paused until you choose a paid plan. Cancellation: If you decide to cancel your Shopify account during the free trial without selecting a pricing plan, then no action is required, and your account is frozen. Billing cycle affects the monthly price: When selecting a plan, monthly billing and annual billing have different total costs. Annual billing charges the full year upfront and presents a lower effective monthly rate. Charges incurred during your free trial If you add apps to your Shopify store during your free trial period, then any app-related charges are included on your next invoice. Switching between plans during your free trial You can switch between Shopify plans during your free trial. The new plan takes effect immediately, but you aren't charged until your free trial period ends. Free trial period length and details The length of your free trial can vary based on different factors. To find out the current trial length and any promotional offers available, visit the free trial page, enter your email address, and then click Start free trial. Note: It's not possible to extend the duration of your free trial period. If you decide to upgrade to a paid plan within your free trial period, then charges wi
